articles.title: How a Pixar Intern and Conan O'Brien Created Toy Story 5's Funniest New Character
articles.summary: Smarty Pants, a potty-training toy with dying batteries, is voiced by Conan O'Brien and designed from an intern's sketch. His low-battery slurring and toilet obsession make him a scene-stealer in the first half of Toy Story 5.

articles.title: A Century of Cool: How Miles Davis Reinvented Jazz (and Himself) Again and Again
articles.summary: On his 100th birthday, Miles Davis is remembered as a restless innovator. From bebop to Kind of Blue to electric fusion, he constantly reshaped jazz. WRTI in Philadelphia is playing his music all day to mark the centennial.

articles.title: Sonny Rollins, Saxophone Colossus Who Practiced on a Bridge, Dies at 95
articles.summary: Jazz titan Sonny Rollins, known for his massive tenor sax sound and legendary practice sessions on the Williamsburg Bridge, died at his Woodstock home. He was 95 and remained a restless, spontaneous artist to the end.
